MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

2. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)

   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 0

   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 12

   B. x ≥ 0 only
